name: go-resource-leak
diff:
diff --git a/http.go b/http.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7777777
--- /dev/null
+++ b/http.go
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+package main
+
+import "net/http"
+
+func readAll(url string) {
+	resp, err := http.Get(url)
+	if err != nil {
+		return
+	}
+	buf := make([]byte, 4096)
+	resp.Body.Read(buf)
+}

defects.description: resp.Body is never closed; the connection leaks and cannot be reused
